# Proverbs 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** My-son, my-teaching do-not-forget, and-my-commandments let-your-heart keep,

**2** For length-of days and-years-of life and-peace they-will-add to-you.

**3** Lovingkindness and-truth — let-them-not-forsake-you; bind-them upon your-neck, write-them upon [the]-tablet-of your-heart.

**4** And-find favor and-good-understanding in-[the]-eyes-of God and-man.

**5** Trust in YHWH with-all your-heart, and-upon your-[own]-understanding do-not-lean.

**6** In-all your-ways know-Him, and-He will-make-straight your-paths.

**7** Do-not-be wise in-your-[own]-eyes; fear YHWH and-turn-away from-evil.

**8** Healing it-will-be for-your-navel, and-refreshment for-your-bones.

**9** Honor YHWH from-your-wealth, and-from-[the]-firstfruits-of all your-produce,

**10** And-they-will-be-filled, your-storehouses [with]-plenty, and-[with]-new-wine your-vats will-burst.

**11** Discipline-of YHWH, my-son, do-not-reject, and-do-not-loathe His-correction,

**12** For whom YHWH loves He-corrects, and-like-a-father the-son [in whom] he-delights.

**13** Blessed-[is the]-man [who]-finds wisdom, and-the-man [who]-obtains understanding.

**14** For her-profit [is]-better-than profit-of silver, and-her-yield [more]-than fine-gold.

**15** Precious she [is] more-than corals, and-all your-desires cannot-compare to-her.

**16** Length-of days [is] in-her-right-hand; in-her-left-hand riches and-honor.

**17** Her-ways [are] ways-of pleasantness, and-all her-paths [are] peace.

**18** A-tree-of life she [is] to-those-taking-hold-of-her, and-those-holding-her-fast [are]-called blessed.

**19** YHWH by-wisdom founded [the]-earth; He-established [the]-heavens by-understanding.

**20** By-His-knowledge the-deeps were-split-open, and-[the]-clouds drip dew.

**21** My-son, let-them-not-slip from-your-eyes; keep sound-wisdom and-discretion,

**22** And-they-will-be life for-your-soul, and-grace for-your-neck.

**23** Then you-will-walk on-your-way securely, and-your-foot will-not-stumble.

**24** When-you-lie-down you-will-not-be-afraid; and-you-will-lie-down and-your-sleep will-be-pleasant.

**25** Do-not-be-afraid of-sudden dread, or-of [the]-storm-of [the]-wicked when-it-comes,

**26** For YHWH will-be at-your-side, and-He-will-keep your-foot from-capture.

**27** Do-not-withhold good from-its-owners, when-it-is in-[the]-power-of your-hand to-do [it].

**28** Do-not-say to-your-neighbor, 'Go and-return, and-tomorrow I-will-give,' when-there-is with-you.

**29** Do-not-devise against your-neighbor evil, when-he dwells [in]-trust with-you.

**30** Do-not-contend with-a-man without-cause, if he-has-not-dealt you evil.

**31** Do-not-envy [the]-man-of violence, and-do-not-choose any-of his-ways.

**32** For [the]-devious [is an]-abomination-of YHWH, but-His-counsel [is]-with [the]-upright.

**33** Curse-of YHWH [is] in-[the]-house-of [the]-wicked, but-[the]-dwelling-of [the]-righteous He-blesses.

**34** If the-scoffers He-scoffs-at, yet-to-[the]-humble He-gives grace.

**35** Honor the-wise will-inherit, but-fools carry-away disgrace.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:3**: Chesed ve-emet — 'lovingkindness and truth,' a word pair (hendiadys) expressing covenant faithfulness. Central to Hebrew theology.

- **3:18**: Etz chayyim (tree of life) — echoes Genesis 2-3. Wisdom is here identified with access to life itself.

- **3:19**: YHWH by wisdom founded the earth — anticipates the extended personification of Wisdom in chapter 8.

— EMET
